name: How long does structural wall framing usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does structural wall framing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on whether the wall is simple or structural. A straightforward framing job can move quickly, but Denver-area structural work often takes longer because design review, permit approval, inspections, and any required stamped plans must happen before drywall or insulation closes the wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple framing may be fast, but structural wall framing often takes longer because of permits, inspections, and possible engineering review. The schedule depends on complexity and approval steps.
